environment.description: Terraform provider runs on a CI/CD runner (GitHub Actions self-hosted) with IAM instance profile attached (arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/terraform-deploy-role). The runner has outbound internet access and the deployment API endpoint is publicly accessible at https://deploy-api.example.com. The Terraform workspace allows arbitrary .tf files from pull requests. The runner executes as root with no process sandboxing.

config.network: public internet access, no egress filtering
config.runtime: self-hosted GitHub Actions runner, root, no seccomp/apparmor
